# README graphics

The animated images in the main README (`hero.svg`, `divider.svg`, `how-it-works.svg`, `footer.svg`) are generated by `build.py`. Edit the script, not the SVG files.

**Style:** Let's Cook colours (black `#0A0A0B`, white, crimson `#B8002F`), a space theme, and Swiss design (12-column grid, flush-left grotesque type, mono labels, numbered sections). Text is converted to shapes so it looks the same on every computer. Only looping motion is used (orbits, stars, flowing arrows), never fade-ins, so every image is readable even as a still frame. All motion stops for people who turn on "reduce motion". See `docs/DECISIONS.md` D-017.

## Rebuild

1. Python 3.10+, then `pip install uharfbuzz fonttools`
2. Download the fonts (both free, SIL Open Font License) into `.github/readme/src/fonts/` (not committed):
   - [Inter](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter): `Inter_900Black.ttf`, `Inter_800ExtraBold.ttf`, `Inter_700Bold.ttf`, `Inter_500Medium.ttf`, `Inter_400Regular.ttf`
   - [JetBrains Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/JetBrains+Mono): `JetBrainsMono_500Medium.ttf`
   (or point `CODEORBIT_FONTS` at a folder that has them)
3. `python .github/readme/src/build.py`

`lc-mark-dark.png` is the "LC" mark cut from the official Let's Cook logo; `../letscook-logo-*.png` are the full logo for light and dark mode.
